name: Turcas Holding A.S.
summary: Turcas Holding A.S. operates as a petrol and energy-focused investment company in Turkey. It operates through Petrol and Electricity segments. The company's products include lubricants, fuel, and engine oil. It is also involved in the power generation activities. Turcas Holding A.S. was formerly known as Turcas Petrol A.S. and changed its name to Turcas Holding A.S. in August 2025. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Turcas Holding A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Aksoy Girisimcilik Enerji Ve Turizm A.S.
